author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
 PTN005163920 (PTHR48094)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Fly DJ-1alpha (FBgn0033885)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation?

This node is annotated with [glyoxalase III activity](http://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0019172). 
This activity of the DJ-1/PfpI-superfamily is experimentally well established in fungi and bacteria (and maybe also plants and nematodes), but its assignment to Drosophila rests on homology and is directly contradicted by the one experimental study that tested it (PMID: 27903648). It seems to be unclear/debated whether taxa outside those experimentally annotated really have this activity?
Could you review, and see if propagation of this annotation should be restrained?

Thanks!
title: PAINT issue: PTN005163920 (PTHR48094)

author: marcfeuermann
body: This family, as currently presented, includes 7 horizontal gene transfer events and more than 40 duplication events (at all levels of evolution). Furthermore, the annotations do not match between species located in the same nodes. So I simply deleted all the old annotations and made only very localized PAINTing. This is what I call an unPAINTable family ;-)
